working_tree_note: Includes uncommitted work beyond HEAD. Exact fingerprints identify reviewed inputs; no clean commit or refinement proof is claimed.

mapping.Open: lobo_sqlite_open_v1 registers connection before callbacks; SQLite owns heap allocation until registration
mapping.Prepare/ReadRow/DoneStatement/Finalize: prepare, step, finalize; owned parent token; finalization is available after query quotas are exhausted
mapping.Begin/Write/Commit/Rollback: transaction guard requires correct autocommit state and no live statements; successful writable step is abstracted as one write; engine failures stutter at this abstraction
mapping.Derive: restrict requires requested mask subset of parent rights; opened connection copies rights
mapping.Exit: finalize every statement, disable progress, rollback pending transaction, close connections, release capabilities before OS/arena cleanup

exclusions: SQLite engine correctness and filesystem/crash durability
C memory safety, compiler typing and ABI correctness
concurrency, secure VFS, hostile parent directory replacement
automatic implementation refinement or liveness proof
